title: Passwords
description: The Bitwarden or Vaultwarden account agents sign in to websites and services with. Elysium runs the official Bitwarden CLI itself, and agents can read only the logins in the one collection you choose for them, never the rest of the vault.
adminOnly: Only admins can manage the password vault.
loadError: The password vault could not be loaded.

form.heading: Connect a vault
form.serverHint: Where the account lives. Bitwarden's own servers are fixed; a self-hosted server names its URL.
form.serverUrlHint: The address you open the web vault at, such as https://vault.example.com.
form.clientIdHint: Starts with user. From the account's API key, not an organization's.
form.clientSecretKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored client_secret.
form.masterPasswordHint: Unlocks the vault inside Elysium. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.masterPasswordKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored master password.
form.checkedHint: Elysium signs in and unlocks the vault before saving anything. This can take a minute.
form.refusedTitle: The vault did not accept these credentials

errors.serverUrlInvalid: Enter an https URL without a username, password, query, or fragment.
errors.clientIdShape: A personal API key's client_id starts with user.
errors.tooLong: This is longer than the vault allows.

setup.title: Set up the account
setup.description: Give agents an account and a collection of their own, so they reach only what you put there.
setup.collection: In Bitwarden, create a collection in an organization for Elysia, and move or share into it only the logins agents may use.
setup.account: Use an account that can read that collection. A dedicated account for Elysia keeps your own vault out of reach entirely.
setup.apiKey: In that account's web vault, open Settings, Security, Keys, and choose View API key. Copy client_id and client_secret.
setup.masterPassword: Have the account's master password ready. The CLI needs it to unlock the vault.

overview.failedTitle: The vault is not available to agents
overview.startingDescription: Elysium is signing the CLI in and unlocking the vault.

collection.heading: Collection for agents
collection.description: Agents can read only the logins in this collection. Choose one the account reaches; until you do, agents read nothing.
collection.label: Collection
collection.loadError: The collections could not be loaded.
collection.notReady: The collections appear once the vault is ready.

remove.confirm: Agents lose the vault at their next turn, and Elysium forgets its credentials. The Bitwarden account is untouched; revoke its API key there to be sure it is never used again.
